newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Emperor says to lose 1,500 oz gold.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Emperor says to lose 1,500 oz gold.

text.p: Emperor Mines Ltd said on Monday it would lose about 1,500 ounces of gold production at its Vatukoula mine in Fiji due to a cylone that temporarily halted operations late last week.
Cyclone Gavin caused the mine to shut for about 28 hours starting last Friday, although by Saturday afternoon 90 percent of production had resumed, Emperor said.
Due to heavy rains, full production was not expected to be reached until March 13, the company said.
"Costs for the third quarter are expected to be higher due to pumping associated with removal of water and debris coupled with employee overtime, Emperor said.
"The cyclone did not cause cause any major injury to the Vatukoula workforce nor damage to the mine infrastructure," Emperor said.
Emperor last month said it was under pressure to reach its target production of 140,000 ounces in its current fiscal year ending June 30 at the Vatukoula mine due to needed maintenance work.
Gavin lashed the South Pacific nation of Fiji on Thursday and Friday with winds of up to 240 kph (150 mph), killing at least two people and damaging scores of houses and electrical facilities.
